name: Feature request
about: A new command, data source, output, or a better way to do something gitrecon already does
title: ''
labels: enhancement

---

**The need**
What are you trying to find out or do? Ex. "I want to see which of a user's repositories ..."

**What you would like**
The command, option or output you imagine. An example of the call and of the result helps most.

**Where it belongs**
[collecting (GitHub, feeds, archives) / mapping and diagrams / reading code (PeekerLex, CaptorLex) /
reading text (humanish, translation) / the map dataset / docs / not sure]

**Alternatives you considered**
Other tools or workarounds you tried.

**Additional context**
Links, examples of data, sketches.
